confirmedNewBugs.title: Sorting rows re-evaluates a relocated aggregate formula against its absolute range at the new position: a correct =SUM result becomes #CYCLE! after the formula's row moves
reproduction: Fresh 3x3 table via Insert > Table grid picker (header TH row + 2 body rows)
A1(TH)=12, A2=4 seeded; C2=9, C3=3 seeded as sort keys
Real click into A3 (body row 2, col A) > Insert > Table formula > =SUM(A1:A2) > Apply -> displays 16 (correct)
Real click into C2 (body cell of sort-key column) > right-click cell > 'Sort by this column'
Rows reorder correctly by C (3-row before 9-row; header excluded) — but the formula cell relocates from body row 2 to body row 1 and is re-evaluated there
confirmedNewBugs.observed: After the sort the previously correct A-cell result 16 becomes #CYCLE!: the formula's range A1:A2 is absolute, and at its new address (A2) the range includes the formula's own cell, so the cycle detector fires. Plain values in the moved rows are preserved; only the aggregate result is corrupted. Two independent reproductions (first exploratory probe + clean re-run with real-input-only formula creation). Sorting from a header caret is a silent no-op (header excluded by design; no feedback).
confirmedNewBugs.expected: Sorting should preserve the correctness of existing formula results (range set translation per B283's fix direction, or relative re-anchoring); a normal row reorder must not corrupt a previously correct aggregate into an error state.
confirmedNewBugs.distinctFromB283: B283 (documented): formula in the NON-moving header row; sortByColumn rewrites the range endpoints (=SUM(A2:A4) -> =SUM(A4:A2)) and calculateTable rejects the reversed range -> #REF!. B301: formula in a MOVING body row; no range rewrite required for the failure — the row relocation makes the unchanged absolute range self-inclusive and the cycle detector fires -> #CYCLE!. Different code path (cycle detection vs token rewriter), different precondition (formula inside vs outside sorted rows — B283's evidence explicitly lists 'formulas inside/outside the sorted rows' as NOT established), different error state (#REF! vs #CYCLE!).

candidatesRejected.title: 'Sort by this column from a header caret is a silent no-op'
candidatesRejected.rationale: Header row is excluded from sorting by design (consistent with B283's documented repro which clicks a body cell); the body-caret route works. Absence of a 'cannot sort from header' toast is a UX nicety, not a defect.

candidatesRejected.title: C3 stale-field value change after first exploratory sort (textContent-seeded cell)
candidatesRejected.rationale: The cell had been seeded via textContent over a live formula field, bypassing input pipelines that normally clear field bindings; the sort's re-evaluation then surfaced the stale binding. Re-run with real-keyboard input only reproduced nothing of the sort — lesson recorded: never seed contenteditable cells via textContent when field state matters.
